judged_text: `i.content.scrub` raises NoMethodError when a feed item has no content element (plain RSS feeds expose `description`, not `content`; malformed items omit both), and the exception aborts the whole loop before any later item is imported. Because `sidekiq_options retry: false`, the hourly poll job dies on the first bad item and every item after it is silently dropped — feed import permanently stalls with no error surfaced to the operator until the next poll hits the same item again.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop unconditionally does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` for each `rss.items` entry. If `i.content` is `nil` (e.g., feeds providing `description` instead of `content`, or malformed items), calling `.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError` and abort the entire job before later items are processed. There is no per-item rescue, and the job is configured with `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so a single bad item can repeatedly kill the hourly poll and prevent subsequent imports.
